source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Account Manager catches account setup errors per account, clears child panels, sets validAccount=false and continues building the list. Its chat protocol icon lookup is guarded by validAccount. about:support also catches each account and appends placeholder data, so one corrupted buddy database need not prevent diagnostics for the other accounts. This protects display and removal paths; it does not repair the database. The current placeholder still spells sokectType incorrectly, so that typo is not a naming example. A broken-profile runtime test and the placeholder accessible name were not checked here.
title: Confine a broken account to its placeholder and avoid repeating the failed lookup
